analysis_policy.bootstrap_draw: multinomial(K, uniform probability over sorted unique CIK clusters)
analysis_policy.bootstrap_empty_group: reject whole draw and redraw; never drop or renormalize a group
analysis_policy.bootstrap_estimand: cluster multiplicity times each task; not equal company means
analysis_policy.bootstrap_shared_weights: all arms, seeds, pools and task groups in the same draw
analysis_policy.interval: paired percentile, 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles, linear interpolation
analysis_policy.positive_confirmation: B interval lower bound strictly greater than zero
analysis_policy.upper_bound_at_least_5pp: cannot exclude a benefit of at least five percentage points
analysis_policy.utility_aggregation: task mean within each group, then equal mean of three groups

policy.JSON_or_length_handling: unaltered response passed to original runtime; no host continuation
policy.context_admission: full prompt tokens plus all 2048 reserved new tokens <=24576
policy.context_rejection: persist attempted callback without calling model; terminate this session
policy.eos_pad_bos_authority: actual bound base generation configuration and tokenizer assets
policy.output: complete generated token IDs and exact decoded text; only final actual EOS removed

execution_policy.GPU_allocation: ascending idle physical index; persistent UUID before spawn
execution_policy.failure: stop launching; finish in-flight jobs; retain failures and not-started denominator
execution_policy.no_move: stop after A dev; no B training or confirmation

parallel_tail_rng_policy.initial_state: capture native CUDA generator immediately after original seeded LoRA load
parallel_tail_rng_policy.offset_calibration: one native BF16 dropout for each distinct [1,L,3584] shape; restore state
parallel_tail_rng_policy.package_offset: cumulative offsets in parent serial 400-update/package/segment order
parallel_tail_rng_policy.replay: restore original generator seed and offset before each assigned trajectory segment

parallel_tail_training_configuration.admission: complete 10240 denominator; all 200 tasks supported in each pool; |S|>=60; separate release
parallel_tail_training_configuration.dropout_rng_correlation_change: shared causal prefix uses one dropout realization within each package; this execution is not bitwise-equivalent to separate response-row forwards
parallel_tail_training_configuration.event_durability: buffered package events; flush+fsync once per optimizer update
parallel_tail_training_configuration.packages_per_update: all valid train originals for scheduled five tasks; variable

parallel_policy.empty_ranks: zero local gradient contribution; still join the single global SUM
parallel_policy.gradient_reduction: one packed FP32 all_reduce(SUM) per global update; never average
parallel_policy.partition: stable longest-sequence-token-first package assignment; serial order within rank
parallel_policy.replication: full BF16 base plus identical FP32 LoRA on every rank
parallel_policy.update: one local zero; local weighted SUM; global SUM; one clip and AdamW step per replica

parallel_rng_policy.offset_calibration: one native BF16 dropout for each distinct [1,L,3584] shape; restore state

parallel_tail_training_configuration.per_pool_token_budget: ten times cache forward-segment sequence tokens; original packages and targets unchanged
parallel_tail_training_configuration.physical_order: frozen session-id package order restricted to scheduled tasks; prefix union
parallel_tail_training_configuration.production_initialization: fresh base plus paired seeded LoRA; empty AdamW state; never engineering state
parallel_tail_training_configuration.representation: one longest original causal sequence plus union of every original response target per exact-prefix package; unchanged original rows on nonprefix packages
parallel_tail_training_configuration.runtime_failure: retain records, fail closed, no automatic seed/hyperparameter rerun
parallel_tail_training_configuration.shared_host_admission: base checkpoint SHA once and existing numeric cache SHA once; child private admission plus file stat signatures
parallel_tail_training_configuration.source_material_budget: retained separately; never relabel original token cost as executed
parallel_tail_training_configuration.task_schedule: prospective fixed 200-task metadata population; ten visits each
parallel_tail_training_configuration.update: zero_grad once; all original packages of five tasks; clip once; step once
parallel_tail_training_configuration.validation: original file bytes and exact prefix/targets verified once when cache is made; cache arrays verified once on worker load; no per-update material validation
